messages:
incident-bot: Pager (sev=2) — high KV cache eviction rate in prod us-west-2. Affected routes: /generate, /embed. Symptoms: elevated p95/p99 latency, elevated GPU QPS. Page: @sara-eng-oncall, @mike-sre. Start: 2026-03-16 22:11 UTC

sara-eng-oncall: I'm on the bridge (zoom.us/j/xxxxxxxx). Triage in progress. Will post initial impact. :phone: 

mike-sre: looking at shard metrics — eviction spikes line up with a burst of small requests. Could be bad batching + small seqs.

sara-eng-oncall: Confirming customer impact: internal alerting shows ~8% error-surfacing to downstream clients for 10m window, otherwise latency only. Julia, Kevin: any high-priority customer comms?

julia-product: Not seeing escalations yet. Kept PMs informed. If errors hit >10% we should prepare a banner.

kevin-support: I've queued a watch on top customer accounts that surfaced errors, reaching out proactively. Help link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1745012345

ops-coordinator: Recording mitigation steps in the incident doc: RDW-INC-2026-03-16-01. Please add action items there.

sara-eng-oncall: Quick mitigation applied: disabled aggressive prefix caching on two culprit nodes (commands below). Observed drop in eviction rate, tail latency improved.

sara-eng-oncall: ```
# revert aggressive cache policy
curl -X POST https://infra.internal/api/cache/policy -d '{"policy":"balanced"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

mike-sre: Confirmed metrics trending back to baseline. Rolling monitor for 30m.

nina-eng-platform: Noted config drift between canary and prod; canary had updated batching thresholds. We'll reconcile.

sara-eng-oncall: Good catch. For now mitigation stands. Going to collect traces and KV cache histograms for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status -> mitigated (partial). Next step: post-incident review scheduled.

ops-coordinator: Action: schedule postmortem sync in 48 hours. Proposed slots: Fri 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC or Mon 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC. Please react with :thumbsup: for preferred time.

mike-sre: :thumbsup: Fri 16:00 works for infra folks.

julia-product: :thumbsup: Fri 16:00 preferred — helps align with Q2 roadmap planning.

ops-coordinator: Booked: Postmortem review -> 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent to participants.

ops-coordinator: Creating remediation tickets and sizing now. Summary of candidates: 
- RDW-2026-451: Reconcile batching thresholds between canary/prod (owner: nina-eng-platform) — size: M — priority: P0 (prevent recurrence)
- RDW-2026-452: Add automated detection for eviction storms tied to small-request bursts (owner: mike-sre) — size: S — priority: P1
- RDW-2026-453: Implement safe fallback policy to degrade non-critical cache aggressiveness under high eviction (owner: sara-eng-oncall) — size: M — priority: P0
- RDW-2026-454: Customer comms postmortem & credit analysis (owner: kevin-support) — size: S — priority: P2

sara-eng-oncall: I accept RDW-2026-453. Est. 5 dev-days including testing and rollout.

nina-eng-platform: I accept RDW-2026-451. Est. 8 dev-days; will need coordination with runtime team. Marking for Q2 infra sprint.

mike-sre: RDW-2026-452 assigned to me. Small spike detection + alert rule should be ~3 dev-days.

julia-product: Linking RDW-2026-451 to Q2 roadmap (reduce tail latency target). We should prioritize P0 items into the next infra sprint.

ops-coordinator: Noted. Action owners, please add acceptance criteria to each ticket before EOD tomorrow. We'll use the postmortem to review RCA artifacts and finalize priorities.

kevin-support: I'll draft customer comms after postmortem. For now flagged impacted customers and queued support follow-ups.

mike-sre: One more note: add a short-term guard in routing to redirect heavy small-request traffic to isolated capacity while we fix batching. Small mitigation ticket: RDW-2026-455 (size: S, owner: mike-sre).

sara-eng-oncall: Adding that. If routing guard lands, we can avoid burst-induced thrash during traffic anomalies.

incident-bot: Postmortem meeting created and tickets linked. Incident severity set to Sev2, final label: eviction-storm.

julia-product: Thanks everyone — good mitigation and clear next steps. See you at the postmortem. :raised_hands:

kevin-support: Logged customer impact notes into RDW-2026-454 and linked sample stack traces. 

nina-eng-platform: Will push canary config to staging for validation tomorrow.

sara-eng-oncall: Closing live bridge. If anything regresses ping me or reopen the incident channel. :white_check_mark:

mike-sre: Closing my monitor watch. Follow-ups in tickets.

ops-coordinator: Final: owners, sizes, priorities captured. We'll track remediation in the quarterly planning board (Q2 infra).
